trajectory_decision.future_scope: Production default/release promotion requires its separately reviewed integration and validation.

limitations: Small fresh-process samples on one shared M5 Max; activity checks cannot establish GPU exclusivity or controlled thermals.

Warmed calls correlate within a process. Every completed valid observation is retained; the variable first micro block was repeated in a balanced block; residual near-full timing variation was investigated in an isolated BAAB block, with identical optimized HLO across arms in every block.
The synthetic near-full regression is not an AF2 regression. Microbenchmark absolute times across review and worker periods are not directly comparable.
V4 trajectory times remain labeled v4. No full v5 trajectory timing is claimed.
Historical 196-dispatch deficits remain unresolved; fresh exact accounting does not explain historical calls lacking arrays/traces.
No production release, installer pins, default flags, scientific settings or scheduling thresholds changed.
